attr.title: Threes!
attr.desc: Slide and combine numbered cards. Original Android game adapted for RG35XX-H/KNULLI, with controller support, TATE and local saves.
attr.inst: Copy threes-free-3-1-24576.xapk into ports/threesandroid and launch Threes!. Setup is automatic. Requires Free 3.1 (24576), including the ARM64 split.
